title.zh: 查询负载均衡器区域信息

descriptions.zh: 通过 OpenAPI 创建负载均衡器“基于国家/区域调度”策略时，使用一级或二级区域的代码表示从此地理区域来源的流量。
descriptions.en: When you create a country/region-based scheduling policy for a load balancing instance by calling an OpenAPI operation, use the primary or secondary region code from the lookup table to represent traffic originating from the corresponding geographic region.
